title: docs(adr): renumber the token/scope-tree ADR 0037 → 0039 (resolve collision)
body:
Resolves a duplicate ADR-0037 on main: #1694 "Live Canvas" (created 2026-06-10) and #1706 "token tree" (this work, 2026-06-11) both merged as 0037. Live Canvas has precedence; the token-tree ADR yields to the next free number (0038 = Build Verification Loop), so it becomes **0039**. Updates only this work's own references (ADR-0019/0031 forward-refs, flow guide Track A/B links, showcase comments). Live Canvas stays 0037, untouched. Docs build green.
